youtube_short.title: Getting Laid Off Has a $10,668 Hidden Bill
title_alternatives: Your Job Was Paying 70% of Your Health Insurance
COBRA: The $1,778/Month Bill Nobody Warns You About
youtube_short.description: Most people plan for the income gap when they lose their job — but almost nobody budgets for COBRA health insurance, and it costs a family $1,778 every single month. Your employer was quietly covering 70% of that premium while you worked there. Lose the job, lose the subsidy. With the average job search taking 4-6 months, that's nearly $11,000 in health insurance alone before your next paycheck. Here's how to calculate your real emergency fund number. #personalfinance #cobra #healthinsurance #emergencyfund #layoff

hook_line: Your employer was paying 70% of your health insurance. Now it's all on you.
